A1.justification: Both complete, readable 17-page PDFs describe the same AG-REPA research and include Appendices A–C. Text comparison and rendered-page inspection support reliable comparison of the equations, figures, tables, and appendices.

before.justification: v2.pdf reports original audio-generation experiments, layer-attribution measurements, architecture comparisons, and ablations. Tables 1–12 include measured WER, FAD, MOS, and efficiency results.

after.justification: v3.pdf retains the original experiments and appendix analyses, including the generation-quality comparisons in Tables 2–5 and robustness results in Tables 7–12.

M1.justification: Sections 4 and Appendix A retain the same BiT-C, LASP, FoG-A, and AG-REPA procedures, including attribution-based layer selection, weighting, projection heads, and training objectives.

E1.justification: Both versions use LibriSpeech and AudioSet for speech and general-audio generation, with the same token-conditioning configurations. No dataset, task, domain, or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged throughout the corresponding experiments, including fixed, deep, and shallow REPA; random, LASP, and gradient-norm selectors; and the internal self-alignment comparisons in Appendix B.

E3.justification: The evaluation settings remain identical: the 5,000-step diagnostic warm-up, fixed 500k-step checkpoint, extended convergence evaluation, VGGish FAD with 16 kHz audio, and MOS sampling protocol are retained.

E4.justification: The same analyses examine layer-selection criteria, checkpoint stability, selection refresh, timestep-adaptive routing, layer counts and weights, projection heads, and supervision sources. Sections 5 and Appendices A–B contain no added or revised analyses.

E5.justification: Both versions report three independently initialized runs for objective metrics, MOS means with standard errors, the same confidence intervals, and paired sample-level significance testing. Appendix C is unchanged.

E6.justification: All experimental results in the figures, Tables 1–12, and accompanying prose are unchanged. For example, Table 2 reports AG-REPA speech WER 3.45 and speech/audio FAD 1.29/2.56 in both versions.

T1.justification: The residual-network derivation, Jacobian sensitivity argument, attribution definitions, and mathematical objectives are identical. No assumptions, equations, proofs, or formal reasoning are added or corrected.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about Store-Contribute Dissociation, causal layer selection, generation quality, convergence, and transfer across architectures.

C2.justification: Interpretations and limitations are unchanged, including the dependence on token topology, the efficiency trade-off of static selection, possible representation drift during longer training, and the suitability of pooled teacher targets.

D1.justification: Appendices A–C retain the same architectural, implementation, probing, and evaluation details. The code-availability statement and repository address are identical; the new funding acknowledgement adds no technical or resource-access information.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion, research positioning, and cited works are identical. Reference entries move across pages 10–11 because of the acknowledgement insertion; none are added or removed.

P1.justification: v3.pdf adds a short Acknowledgements section naming funding sources and explicitly marks Li Liu as corresponding author. The version stamp also changes. Scientific prose and section ordering otherwise remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The acknowledgement insertion reflows references across pages 10–11, and the corresponding-author note changes the first-page footnote layout. All four figures and twelve tables retain their content, captions, structure, and placement.

improvement.justification: v3.pdf adds funding credits and explicitly marks a corresponding author already identified in v2.pdf. These administrative clarifications and local layout changes leave the scientific argument, evidence, reproducibility information, and limitations unchanged, yielding no meaningful overall quality difference.
